newsitem.title: USA: Thousand Trails sets Dutch auction.
newsitem.headline: Thousand Trails sets Dutch auction.

text.p: Thousand Trails Inc said it had begun a Dutch auction tender offer to acquire as many of its Senior Subordinated Pay-In-Kind Notes Due 2003 as possible for $12 million.
Unless extended, the offer will expire at 1700 EDT on Wednesday, June 18.

A registered holder of notes may tender them from $800 per $1000 of principal amount to $900 per $1,000 of principal amount, in integral multiples of $5 of principal amount, plus a percentage of accrued interest equal to the percentage of principal, it said.
Thousand Trails and its subsidiaries own and operate 58 member ship-based campgrounds located in 19 states and British Columbia, Canada.
